prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-05-07, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-05-07):
| Current ratio           | 0.99 |
| Retained earnings       | 13,060M |
| Current liabilities     | 6,096M |
| Current assets          | 6,043M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 10,004M |
| Total liabilities       | 15,009M |
| Total assets            | 25,041M |
| EBIT / operating income | 622M |
| Revenue                 | 4,066M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company shows decent profitability (EBIT ~15% of revenue) and a moderate leverage profile (total liabilities ~60% of assets) with a current ratio near 1, indicating just-adequate liquidity. On balance, these factors support an investment-grade rating but with some near-term liquidity risks and modest cushion, suggesting a rating in the BBB range, likely BBB+ given the combination of profitability and leverage.

DECISION: BBB+
